approaches.ideaZh: 枚举每一对下标 `i < j`，检查 `nums[i] + nums[j]` 是否等于 `target`。题目保证恰好有一组答案，找到就返回。
approaches.ideaEn: Try every pair of indices `i < j` and check whether `nums[i] + nums[j]` equals `target`. Exactly one pair works, so return it as soon as it turns up.

approaches.nameEn: Hash map, look up then store
approaches.ideaZh: 从左到右扫描，把每个数当成答案里靠右的那个：它的搭档必须是 `target - x`。用哈希表记下已经扫过的值和下标，先查搭档，查不到再存当前数，这样不会让一个数和自己配对。
approaches.ideaEn: Scan left to right and treat each number as the right half of the answer: its partner must be `target - x`. Keep a hash map from the values seen so far to their indices. Look the partner up first and store the current number only afterwards, so no number pairs with itself.

approaches.ideaZh: 左括号入栈；遇到右括号时，栈顶必须是与它配对的左括号，否则无效。扫描结束后栈必须为空。
approaches.ideaEn: Push every opening bracket. A closing bracket must match the opening bracket on top of the stack, or the string is invalid. At the end the stack must be empty.
